title: Flat glass lehr from 1920s
description: This is an image of a flat glass lear used to anneal glass at one of the Libbey-Owens companies. Continuous lehrs began being used in the United States in the 1880s, and by 1915 replaced annealing kilns to a large extent for window glass making.
author: Arthur E. Fowle and Libby-Owens-Ford Glass Company
